name: autonoxis-model
description: Local, free conductor decisions from Polaris 2 (polaris-2), the autonoxis decision model, over the Jev wire format: STOP/ASK/DISPATCH and ACCEPT/VERIFY/REJECT/REOPEN/ESCALATE, gated at confidence 0.8.
